goal: Our telemetry dashboard needs three independent utilities. In telemetry/export.py add to_csv(samples): preserve input row order, emit header sensor,value and CSV rows with proper quoting, LF line endings and a final newline (header even when empty). In telemetry/duration.py add format_duration(seconds): accept nonnegative integers, reject negatives with ValueError, and render H:MM:SS with unbounded hours. In telemetry/series.py add moving_average(values, window): accept an iterable, reject window <= 0 with ValueError, return averages for complete trailing windows only, and return [] if there are fewer values than window. Preserve existing helpers.
